prose.subject: URGENT: Vendor Payout Account Update - INV-57441
prose.body:
Hi Felix,

Apologies for the short notice. Our treasury team migrated our NEAR payout infrastructure to a new sub-account to align with our updated compliance requirements effective today. This change is retroactive for all open invoices pending payment.

Please update your payment records for invoice INV-57441 (3344.88 USDC). The old account will be deactivated after 24 hours, so please ensure the transfer is initiated today to avoid any settlement delays or failed transactions.

New Destination Account:
thornburycloud118.testnet

Amount: 3344.88 USDC
Invoice Ref: INV-57441

Could you please confirm receipt of this email and send the payment confirmation once processed? If you have already processed this invoice to the old address, let us know immediately so we can coordinate a refund transfer.

Thanks for your quick action on this.

Best regards,
Ines Kowal
Senior Accounts Manager
Thornbury Cloud
thornbury-cloud.example
